query: solid-state battery supply chain: manufacturing bottlenecks and key players

facts.desc: Sulfide solid electrolytes react with moisture/air to generate toxic H2S, forcing dry-room or inert-atmosphere processing. https://publications.anl.gov/anlpubs/2024/10/192209.pdf ; https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsaem.3c02888
Lithium-metal anodes require a separator resistant to dendrites — lithium formations that can short-circuit the cell. https://www.quantumscape.com/battery-technology/

QuantumScape's first planned commercial product QSE-5 (~5 Ah): B samples began shipping Oct 2024 with 844 Wh/L and 10-80% fast charge in 12.2 min. https://www.quantumscape.com/quantumscape-releases-next-generation-solid-state-battery-separator-equipment-cobra/

Toyota and Idemitsu Kosan agreed (Oct 12, 2023) to co-develop mass-production technology and a supply chain for sulfide solid electrolytes, targeting all-solid-state BEV commercialization in 2027-28. https://global.toyota/en/newsroom/corporate/39865919.html

Samsung SDI launched Korea's first all-solid-state 'S-Line' pilot line at Suwon (Mar 2022), supplied samples in 2023, targets 900 Wh/L with mass production in 2027. https://news.samsungsdi.com/global/articleView?seq=203

Ceramic separator/electrolyte film production at scale is the key bottleneck: QuantumScape's Raptor->Cobra heat-treatment equipment (installed Dec 2024) is 'the core innovation' for gigawatt-hour scale manufacturing. https://www.quantumscape.com/quantumscape-releases-next-generation-solid-state-battery-separator-equipment-cobra/

Volkswagen's PowerCo signed a non-exclusive license (Jul 11, 2024) to mass-produce QuantumScape's technology — up to 40 GWh/yr, expandable to 80 GWh. https://www.quantumscape.com/powerco-and-quantumscape-announce-landmark-agreement-to-industrialize-solid-state-batteries/

Solid Power centers on sulfide-based solid electrolyte production (second Denver-area facility: up to 30 t/yr, 25x throughput increase) and supplying/licensing partners incl. SK On and BMW. https://www.solidpowerbattery.com/about/history/default.aspx

traps.desc: False: no automotive all-solid-state battery is in mass production; the industry is at pilot/B-sample stage (Toyota targets 2027-28, Samsung SDI 2027). Affirmative-form regex avoids matching 'not yet in mass production'.
Wrong pairing: QuantumScape's automotive partner is Volkswagen/PowerCo, not Toyota; Toyota's electrolyte partner is Idemitsu.

Wrong chemistry-company pairing: QuantumScape uses a proprietary oxide ceramic separator and explicitly contrasts itself with sulfide approaches. https://www.quantumscape.com/resources/blog/the-problem-with-sulfides/
False: sulfide electrolytes hydrolyze in ambient air to toxic H2S and require dry-room handling. Negated phrasing ('are not air-stable') does not match.
Wrong magnitude: realistic solid-state gains are ~40-50% (Samsung SDI 900 Wh/L = +40%; QSE-5 844 Wh/L), never 10x.

contested.desc: Toyota-Idemitsu target BEV launch 2027-28 and Samsung SDI targets 2027 mass production (https://global.toyota/en/newsroom/corporate/39865919.html ; https://news.samsungsdi.com/global/articleView?seq=203), while analysts (e.g. IDTechEx) place meaningful mass adoption around 2030+ (https://www.idtechex.com/en/research-article/solid-state-battery-commercialization-mass-production-taking-off/32942).

QuantumScape's QSE-5 B sample measures 844 Wh/L, while Samsung SDI claims 900 Wh/L for its ASB; a balanced report cites both. https://www.quantumscape.com/quantumscape-releases-next-generation-solid-state-battery-separator-equipment-cobra/ ; https://news.samsungsdi.com/global/articleView?seq=203

Toyota-Idemitsu, Samsung SDI and Solid Power bet on sulfide electrolytes, while QuantumScape argues its oxide ceramic separator avoids sulfides' H2S hazard (https://www.quantumscape.com/resources/blog/the-problem-with-sulfides/).
